name: pyriemann-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pyRiemann, a Python library for machine learning on multivariate data
through the Riemannian geometry of symmetric (or Hermitian) positive definite matrices: matrix
functions, means, distances, geodesics and tangent-space maps, covariance estimation, and
scikit-learn compatible estimators built on them.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the pyriemann package under pyriemann/ together with the documentation that describes it: its docstrings, README.md, the documentation pages doc/index.rst, doc/introduction.rst, doc/installing.rst and doc/api.rst, and the offline example scripts shipped under examples/.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation includes the in-package
docstrings and their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a
comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.
